title: Build Channel
statement: Implement `solve(kind, message)`. `kind` is `email` or `sms`. Return `email:message` or `sms:message`. Any other kind returns `error`. This is a factory function. The caller does not construct the classes.
constraints: The message is included for known kinds
hints: Map kind to a constructor in a dict.
Call send on the new instance.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A factory hides the constructors behind a kind string the edge of the system already has, such as a config value.

editorial: A factory hides the constructors behind a kind string the edge of the system already has, such as a config value. The mapping is the only branch. Callers depend on the send method, not on the class statements.
